question.prompt: After combining like terms, the polynomial \(2x^2+mx-5x+3\) has no first-degree term in \(x\). Find the value of \(m\).

solutions.explanation: The first-degree terms combine to give \((m-5)x\). Having no first-degree term means that its coefficient satisfies \(m-5=0\), so \(m=5\).
solutions.title: Make the first-degree coefficient zero
